answer: Each newcomer locks one marble in a horizon vault for twelve epochs and grows a juniper record: one verified, signed contribution per epoch, chained to the last, with growth capped at one unit per epoch. At the horizon the marble unlocks only if the juniper record shows twelve distinct contributions; a copied or idle record forfeits the marble. Clones each need their own marble locked for the full horizon and their own twelve-epoch record, because time cannot be parallelized and one contribution cannot count for two identities, so the tenth fake costs ten marbles and ten horizons of waiting.
